comment: What the quests stage in the world (ULyudQuestDirector, docs/quests.md). pickups: an item lying out while its quest is on one of the stages; ux, uy, floor_uz are Unreal metres as in PeopleData/people_places.json (the floor under it; it drops from drop_m above onto whatever stands there), yaw the way its top points. listeners: people who notice a bird calling beside them; the first reaction that fits is said (species, quest + stage, air = called on the wing near by); the quests get bird_call <Species>.<Body> when the bird sat within within_m. remarks: a person says the lines of their own accord, once, when the hero walks within within_m while the quest is on one of the stages.
